entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit, I don't care if that dude used to[n]be nobility or whatever. I can't believe[n]he's mockin' us!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It didn't seem like he had any intention[n]of listening to what we had to say.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But we have to do something about him,[n]right? Let's go, everyone!
